test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

My manager forced me to resign from my job as a chef since I underwent a spine surgery. I was depressed and had lost all hope. Later my father motivated me to open my own café and showed me ways to be independent. After all it is true that one should not __________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"cry over spilt milk"** means to be upset about something that has already happened and cannot be changed. (बीती बात पर पछताना)

 
 
• **Example: **It's no use **crying over spilt milk**; let's focus on finding a solution instead.
 
 
 
• **"Cry over spilt milk" **refers to the act of lamenting or being upset over something that has already occurred and cannot be undone. (बीती बात पर पछताना)
 
 
• **Example: **After losing the game, he realized it was pointless to **cry over spilt milk **and started preparing for the next match.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct idiom to fill in the blank is **"cry over spilt milk"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grease the palm** (घूस देना): To bribe someone.

 
 
• **Example:** He had to **grease the palm** of the official to get his work done.
 
 
 
• **Blow one’s own trumpet** (अपनी प्रशंसा करना): To boast or brag about one's own achievements.
 
 
• **Example: ** He is always **blowing his own trumpet** about his sales achievements.
 
 
 
• **Blow hot and cold** (मन बदलना): To frequently change one's opinion.
 
 
• **Example:** Her opinions on the matter keep** blowing hot and cold.**
 
 

 

1b0:Tbad,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
